faq: Which CRMs can it connect to?
HubSpot, Zoho, Pipedrive, Salesforce and others with standard connections or an automation tool. We check your CRM and chat tool first, and tell you the simplest connection that works.
Do you send full chat transcripts?
By default we send a short summary and key answers, not the whole transcript, to keep notes useful and respect privacy. You can choose to send the full text if your policy allows it.
We match on email address first, and update the existing contact instead of adding a new one. Standard and Premium include this matching, and we test it with sample duplicates.
Do I need an automation tool?
Sometimes. If a direct connection is not available, we use a tool such as Zapier or Make. Any subscription is billed to you, and we tell you the likely cost before we begin.

desc:
Chat to CRM sync sends every lead and conversation note from your sales assistant into your customer database. Ecom Swift LLC connects the two, maps the fields correctly and tests the flow, so your team sees each lead with the context it needs.

## What is chat to CRM sync?

Chat to CRM sync is a connection that creates or updates a contact in your CRM whenever your chat assistant captures a lead. The contact arrives with name, email, phone, the page the visitor came from and a short summary of what they asked about.

Without this link, leads sit inside the chat tool where only one person looks, or they are copied by hand into a spreadsheet days later. Hand copying loses details, creates duplicates and delays the first reply, which is the moment that matters most.

## How synced leads change your sales follow up

A sales team can only act on what it can see. When a lead lands in the CRM with the conversation summary attached, the first message can refer to what the person actually asked, not a generic introduction. That is a better experience for the buyer and a faster start for the seller.

Source information helps your planning as well. When each contact carries the page it started from, you can see which products or articles bring serious enquiries. Deals created with a sensible stage give the pipeline an honest shape. None of this promises more sales, but it removes the delays and gaps that quietly waste good leads.

## What a good sync includes

- Contacts created with name, email and phone in the right CRM fields.
- The source page saved, so you know what prompted the chat.
- A short chat summary stored as a note on the contact.
- Matching against existing contacts so one person never appears twice.
- A lead owner chosen by a simple rule, such as region or product.
- An alert to the owner when a new lead arrives.
- A deal created in your pipeline when the conversation shows buying intent.
- A stage set from the topic of the chat.
- A log of what was sent and when.
- An error alert for leads that fail to sync.

## How we build it

First we look at your CRM, the fields you use and who owns which leads. We agree a mapping on paper before touching anything, so each piece of chat data has a clear destination.

Then we build the connection, write the rules for matching and ownership and run sample chats through it. We check that a returning contact is updated instead of duplicated and that unusual inputs, like a missing phone number, do not break the record. Basic sends leads as contacts with a source. Standard adds summaries, duplicate matching, owner rules and alerts. Premium adds deals, stage rules, a sync log and error alerts, plus a period of fixes after launch.

## Do and avoid

**Do:**
- Decide in advance which CRM fields are required and which are optional.
- Keep the chat summary short and factual.
- Name a single owner for leads that do not match any rule.
- Check the sync log regularly during the first weeks.
- Tell visitors in your privacy wording that chat details are stored.

**Avoid:**
- Pushing full transcripts into the CRM when a summary is enough.
- Creating a new contact for every message from the same person.
- Mapping several chat fields into one CRM field.
- Letting failed syncs go unnoticed.
- Storing sensitive information that your team has no reason to keep.

## Who this is for

This suits a store or business whose chat already brings in enquiries, but whose team works from a CRM and cannot see chat leads there. It suits a B2B seller with a pipeline and several salespeople. It also suits a growing company that has outgrown a shared inbox and wants each lead tracked from first message to deal.

If you do not use a CRM yet, tell us. We can discuss a simple option before connecting anything.

## What we need from you

Share the name of your CRM, a list of the fields you want filled, your ownership rules and a few examples of what a good lead record looks like. Tell us whether you want deals created automatically.

We do the work inside your own accounts, and passwords are never requested. Access is given as a user, collaborator or developer role where the tool allows it, and you can remove it whenever you choose. After you order, we send a short checklist and keep you updated until the first live lead arrives correctly.
